name: Croydon
text: Croydon is a large town in South London, England, 9.5 miles (15 km) south of Charing Cross. Part of the London Borough of Croydon, a local government district of Greater London; it is one of the largest commercial districts in Greater London, with an extensive shopping area. The entire town had a population of 192,064 as of 2011, whilst the wider borough had a population of 384,837.

depictions.name: Croydon
depictions.text: Croydon, also known as Croindene during the Medieval period, is a town and borough in southeast England. It was originally part of the county of Suthsexe before being grouped as part of Greater London.
